title: Vasya the Hipster
statementMd:
One day Vasya the Hipster decided to count how many socks he had. It turned out that he had $*a*$ red socks and $*b*$ blue socks.

According to the latest fashion, hipsters should wear the socks of different colors: a red one on the left foot, a blue one on the right foot.

Every day Vasya puts on new socks in the morning and throws them away before going to bed as he doesn't want to wash them.

Vasya wonders, what is the maximum number of days when he can dress fashionable and wear different socks, and after that, for how many days he can then wear the same socks until he either runs out of socks or cannot make a single pair from the socks he's got.

Can you help him?

## Input

The single line of the input contains two positive integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 100$) — the number of red and blue socks that Vasya's got.

## Output

Print two space-separated integers — the maximum number of days when Vasya can wear different socks and the number of days when he can wear the same socks until he either runs out of socks or cannot make a single pair from the socks he's got.

Keep in mind that at the end of the day Vasya throws away the socks that he's been wearing on that day.

## Note

In the first sample Vasya can first put on one pair of different socks, after that he has two red socks left to wear on the second day.
statementZhMd:
一天，潮人 Vasya 决定数一数自己有多少只袜子。结果发现，他有 $*a*$ 只红袜子和 $*b*$ 只蓝袜子。

按照最新的时尚潮流，潮人应该穿不同颜色的袜子：左脚穿红袜子，右脚穿蓝袜子。

Vasya 每天早上穿上新袜子，并在睡觉前将其扔掉，因为他不想清洗袜子。

Vasya 想知道，他最多可以有多少天穿着不同颜色的袜子，保持时尚；之后，他还可以有多少天穿着相同颜色的袜子，直到袜子用完，或者无法用现有的袜子组成一双袜子。

你能帮助他吗？

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行包含两个正整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 100$）——Vasya 拥有的红袜子和蓝袜子的数量。

## 输出格式

输出两个以空格分隔的整数——Vasya 可以穿不同颜色袜子的最大天数，以及在此之后他可以穿相同颜色袜子的天数，直到袜子用完或无法用现有的袜子组成一双袜子。

请注意，每天结束时，Vasya 会扔掉当天穿过的袜子。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vasya 可以先穿一双不同颜色的袜子，之后还剩下两只红袜子，可以在第二天穿。
